richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Ramgarh

c: Ramgarh is a cantonment town on the Chota Nagpur plateau, known for its regimental centres and the coal belt around it. Fitness is part of daily routine for many families here, and parks and colony grounds see steady use. FunPlay Systems supplies open air gym equipment to Ramgarh from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,390 km away by road. Our dealers in the eastern region help with installation and after-sales visits.

We make every machine in-house, from the galvanised frame to the moulded seats and handles. Buyers in Ramgarh include schools, residential colonies, municipal parks and mining company townships. Whoever the buyer, the process is the same. You share the site size and photos, we propose the machines and a layout, and after approval we manufacture, dispatch and install with our team or a dealer in the east.
Where users already train regularly, plain body weight stations get more use than gentle machines. The
adds a full-body option that is easy on the knees.

items.q: Can you install outdoor gym equipment on rocky or uneven ground?
items.a: Yes. We usually prepare a level concrete base and grout the posts into it. Photos of the site help us judge what preparation is needed. Your local contractor can do the base work to our drawing if you prefer.

items.q: Which machines suit people who train seriously?
items.a: Body weight stations such as the Pull Up Station, Parallel Bar and Cross Fit frame. They allow dips, pull-ups and similar exercises without any adjustment. Leave enough clear space around them for full arm and leg movement.
Three years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts, and 1 year on springs, bearings and spare parts, covering manufacturing defects when maintained as advised.
